# =====================================================================================
# Hillpointe AP policy, as configuration.
# Every business-rule VALUE lives here. Reference data (vendors, projects, periods,
# allocation %, GL lists) is read live from 02_Reference_Data/Hillpointe_Master_Data.xlsx.
# After editing, run:  uv run ap policy validate
# Section numbers (§) refer to 04_AP_Policy/AP_Coding_Rules_and_Approval_Matrix.docx
# =====================================================================================

# --- §2 Which system and which entity ------------------------------------------------
routing:
  "Active Construction":   {category: construction, system: Sage Intacct, entity: HPC, department: OPS}
  "Stabilized Operations": {category: stabilized,   system: Entrata,      entity: OWNER}   # OWNER = Projects tab owner entity
  corporate:               {category: corporate,    system: Sage Intacct, entity: HCM}

corporate:
  # Used only when neither the invoice nor the vendor master gives a department. null = hold (OTHER).
  default_department: null
  one_time_service_keywords: [implementation, consulting, training, setup, set-up, onboarding, configuration, professional services]
  one_time_service_gl: "65010"

# --- §3 Required dimensions ----------------------------------------------------------
retainage_gl: "20500"
forbidden_gl: ["20000", "25000-25120"]

# --- §5 Pay applications -------------------------------------------------------------
pay_app:
  check_previous_certificates: true
  tolerance: 0.01
lien:
  # A matching standalone conditional waiver already on file satisfies the requirement (assumption A-16)
  accept_waiver_on_file: true
  waiver_amount_tolerance: 0.01
coi:
  grace_days: 0          # COI expiration must be >= bill date - grace_days

# --- §6 PO and contract matching -----------------------------------------------------
overpo:
  tolerance: 500.00      # hold when billed-to-date would exceed PO amount by MORE than this
price_variance:
  action: warn           # warn | hold   (two-way match on unit rate; assumption A-17)
  tolerance_pct: 0.5
service_agreement:
  fee_tolerance: 0.01

# --- §7 Dates and terms --------------------------------------------------------------
periods:
  open_period_override: null   # e.g. "2026-11" to force November open regardless of the Periods tab
entrata_post_month_format: "%m/%Y"   # assumption A-7

# Per-vendor overrides layered over the vendor master (e.g. {V1003: {terms: "Net 45"}})
vendor_overrides: {}

# --- §10 Duplicates -------------------------------------------------------------------
dup:
  strip_prefixes: ["INVOICE", "INV", "BILL", "NO"]   # quoted: bare NO is read by YAML as false
  near_date_days: 7                    # L4 possible-duplicate window (shorter than a monthly cycle)
  revision_after_entered_code: DUP     # DUP | OTHER  (assumption A-11)

# --- Extraction quality gates ---------------------------------------------------------
extraction:
  arithmetic_tolerance: 0.01
  require_grounding: [document_number, total]   # must be found in the PDF text layer

# --- §12 Exception codes -------------------------------------------------------------
exception_codes:
  DUP:     {meaning: "Already entered in Intacct or Entrata, or in a prior run", route: "AP Manager"}
  NOPO:    {meaning: "No PO or subcontract reference, or project cannot be confirmed", route: "Project Manager"}
  OVERPO:  {meaning: "Exceeds remaining PO balance by more than tolerance", route: "Project Manager and Supply Chain"}
  UNAPPCO: {meaning: "Bills a change order that is not executed", route: "Project Manager; return to subcontractor"}
  LIEN:    {meaning: "Required lien waiver missing", route: "Construction Compliance (Projects & Compliance)"}
  COI:     {meaning: "Vendor insurance certificate expired", route: "Construction Compliance (Projects & Compliance)"}
  NEWVEND: {meaning: "Vendor not in the vendor master", route: "Vendor Master team"}
  BANKCHG: {meaning: "Payment instructions or contact details differ from the vendor master", route: "Treasury"}
  OTHER:   {meaning: "Anything else that needs a person", route: "AP Manager"}

# Primary code when a document has several holds (ADR-0006). Fraud risk first.
exception_precedence: [BANKCHG, DUP, NEWVEND, NOPO, UNAPPCO, OVERPO, LIEN, COI, OTHER]

# --- §13 Approval matrix ---------------------------------------------------------------
approvals:
  construction:
    approver: PROJECT_APPROVER          # Projects tab "Approver"
    additional: {title: "VP Construction", when_gross_work_over: 100000}
  stabilized:
    approver: PROJECT_APPROVER
    additional: {title: "Regional Property Manager", when_invoice_over: 5000}
  corporate:
    approver: "Department head, {department}"
    additional: {title: "CFO", when_bill_over: 25000}
  adjustment:
    approver: "AP Manager review"

# --- Rule registry: order matters for the trace; all rules run (no short-circuit) -------
rules:
  - not_a_bill
  - extraction_quality
  - vendor_master
  - payment_details
  - bill_to
  - duplicates
  - po_reference
  - price_variance
  - po_balance
  - change_orders
  - lien_waiver
  - coi
  - pay_app_math
  - credit_original
  - service_agreement_fee
  - embedded_instructions

# --- Entrata GL selection for stabilized invoices (keyword → GL_Entrata account) -------
entrata_gl_keywords:
  "6200-0055": [grounds maintenance, landscaping contract, landscape maintenance, lawn]
  "6200-0075": [pest service, pest control, monthly pest]
  "6200-0080": [termite, rodent, bed bug]
  "6200-0085": [pool and spa maintenance, pool & spa maintenance, pool service, spa service]
  "6300-0145": [pool repair, spa repair, pump repair, heater repair]
  "6300-0155": [pool supplies, chemicals only]
  "6300-0095": [irrigation]
  "6200-0060": [mulch, annuals, pine straw, landscape supplies]
  "6600-0090": [office supplies, paper, toner]
  "6300-0160": [repair, maintenance, elevator, service call]

knobs.label: Over-PO tolerance
knobs.help: Hold (OVERPO) when billed-to-date would exceed the PO by more than this.

knobs.label: Unit price differs from PO
knobs.help: warn = enter it with a Check reading note; hold = hold as OTHER for the AP Manager.

knobs.label: Price variance allowed
knobs.help: Unit-rate difference ignored below this percentage.

knobs.label: VP Construction approval above
knobs.help: Construction bills with gross work above this also need the VP Construction.

knobs.label: Regional Property Manager above
knobs.help: Stabilized-community invoices above this also need the RPM.

knobs.label: CFO approval above
knobs.help: Corporate bills above this also need the CFO.

knobs.label: COI grace period
knobs.help: Insurance certificate may be expired by up to this many days before holding (COI).

knobs.label: Accept a waiver already on file
knobs.help: A matching conditional waiver received earlier satisfies the lien-waiver requirement.

knobs.label: Force open period
knobs.help: Leave empty to use the Periods tab in the master data.

knobs.label: Possible-duplicate window
knobs.help: Same vendor + same amount within this many days is flagged for a person.

knobs.label: Revision of an entered bill
knobs.help: Exception code when a revised invoice arrives after the original was entered.

DUP.meaning: Already entered in Intacct or Entrata, or in a prior run

NOPO.meaning: No PO or subcontract reference, or project cannot be confirmed

OVERPO.meaning: Exceeds remaining PO balance by more than tolerance

UNAPPCO.meaning: Bills a change order that is not executed

NEWVEND.meaning: Vendor not in the vendor master

BANKCHG.meaning: Payment instructions or contact details differ from the vendor master

OTHER.meaning: Anything else that needs a person
